entries.title: Dietary Supplement Multi-Level Marketing Health Scam
entries.anonymized_story: The victims were lured in by an organization selling herbal dietary supplements with promises of low monthly expenses and healthy weight loss. Once involved, the operators pressured participants into attending endless meetings, falsely claimed medical expertise to recommend purchasing additional costly products, and pushed recruitment of new members. This resulted in unexpected financial drain and potential health impacts.

entries.title: Weight Loss Supplement Recrutiment MLM Scam
entries.anonymized_story: The user was contacted via WhatsApp or SMS regarding weight loss supplements. Initially, they were quoted a low entry cost, but the sellers continuously pushed new products and escalated the monthly expenses significantly. When the user stated they could no longer afford the mounting costs, they were pressured to recruit other people to earn a commission, revealing a multi-level marketing trap that cost the user money, trust, emotional wellbeing, and personal safety.

entries.title: Aggressive Upselling and Recruitment MLM Supplement Scam
entries.anonymized_story: The user was approached in person by a representative offering weight loss supplements. After purchasing the initial items at maximum retail price, the sellers continuously pressured the user to buy increasingly expensive new products. When the user stated they could no longer afford the mounting costs, the sellers suggested recruiting new people into the network to offset expenses, shifting the focus toward a multi-level marketing recruitment model.
